title: Replacement of Trestle tower at Chetlat Lighthouse in the UT of Lakshadweep - Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized) at Deep Bhavan, Kochi.
summary: E-tender for fabrication and supply of a 30 m hot-dip galvanized GI trestle tower at Deep Bhavan, Kochi, to replace the trestle tower at Chetlat Lighthouse, Lakshadweep (Kochi Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin (Deep Bhavan, Kadavanthra)

sites.name: Chetlat Lighthouse
sites.work: Replacement of trestle tower (30 m GI trestle tower to be fabricated and supplied)

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Kochi
sites.work: Location for fabrication and supply of the 30 m GI trestle tower

scope.item: Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized)

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to be sent by post/in person before the deadline. Tender fee Nil. Bid Securing Declaration also listed among required documents.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL etc. or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies; OR for contractors from Lakshadweep, work experience with any Government department in island works during last 7 years
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%
Similar works: erection of trestle/lighthouse/communication tower or construction/maintenance of residential/institutional/office building, road etc. or other related civil construction works
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking with list of gazetted/accounts officer relatives serving in MoPSW or DGLL
Copy of EPF/labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
specs: 30 m high GI trestle tower, hot dipped galvanized
notes: Section I NIT only (printed pages 2-6); no BOQ or tower drawings/specifications included. Bid submission 05.08.2026 15:00 to 01.09.2026 15:00; bid query last date 11.08.2026; last date of EMD 31.08.2026 15:00. Listing shows end/opening 2026-09-19, which does not match the document's 01.09.2026 / 02.09.2026 (possibly a date extension not included in the listing documents).
